title: finding(plugin-dashboard,components): date-only strings parsed as UTC midnight outside toDisplayDate — the dashboard custom range and the form date-picker show the previous day west of UTC (the date-only zone family's open closure card)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (a), in the date-only zone family (objectui#10110 → objectui#10183 → PR objectui#10266, all closed). Reader: triage first (route and grade). ⛔ Not graded here.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`) from the objectui#10799 dev report (`5859155332`: `out_of_scope_findings[1]` and `open_questions[0]`, answered 「land as-is, file for the family」) and from the contract review of PR objectui#10838 (`5859296505`, item 5). The family has no open card: objectui#10110 and objectui#10183 are closed. So this card is its **closure card**, and any later read site that parses a date-only string with `new Date(…)` or date-fns rides here.

## Sites

1. **`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardFilterBar.tsx`, the custom range.** It stores `toIsoDate(range.from)` (local `yyyy-MM-dd`) and reads it back with `new Date(value.from)` / `new Date(value.to)`, which is UTC midnight. PR objectui#10838 moves these two expressions, unchanged, into `rangeFrom` / `rangeTo`.
   - Measured by the dev in a forks probe with `process.env.TZ = 'America/Los_Angeles'` (offset 420), the popover passed through: clicking 15 Sep commits `{ from: '2026-09-15', to: '2026-09-15' }` (correct), but the calendar highlights 2026-09-14. Under UTC the control highlights 2026-09-15.
2. **`packages/components/src/renderers/form/date-picker.tsx`, an authored ISO-string `value`.** An authored `value: '2024-01-15'` reaches the component unparsed through `SchemaRenderer`, and date-fns parses a date-only string as UTC. The reviewer probed `startOfMonth` / `isSameDay` in node under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`, and reported that the trigger label reads 「January 14th, 2024」 for `2024-01-15` there. That was at the merge-base, before PR objectui#10838.

## Why

A stored value names a calendar day. West of UTC these faces show and highlight the day before, so an author reads the wrong day back from a correct stored value. The family's repair convention exists: `toDisplayDate` from `@object-ui/core` builds a local-midnight `Date` from a date-only string, and `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` drives each read site under a non-UTC zone in a forks child.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- Route each site's date-only read through `toDisplayDate`.
- Register each site in the zone-pin driver's `PINS`, so the family's census stays enumerated.
- Census the rest: any other `new Date(dateOnly)` or date-fns parse of a stored date-only value in `packages/**` rides here.

## Dedupe

Listed the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (open and closed) and grepped them locally for `date-only|toDisplayDate|10183|west of UTC|UTC midnight`. Every family hit is closed: objectui#10110, #10183, #10301, #10567, #10625, #10474, #10442, #10722 and their PRs. No open card covers these two sites.

Dedupe words: `date-only UTC midnight dashboard range` · `toDisplayDate DashboardFilterBar` · `date-picker ISO string previous day west of UTC`
